[[File:Canoe-ProwBeaten.png|thumb|right|An Ewok canoe]]
A '''canoe''' was a primitive watercraft. The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] canoes were one-person boats used on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] also used canoes.<ref name="Episode">{{Ewoks|Prow Beaten}}</ref> Usually in a diamond-like shape, it used two paddles on each side to propel itself.
